prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / focused pixel-art portrait revision.
Input image 1 is your first-pass portrait EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is the selected original identity master only. Inputs 3–6 are style-only references. Preserve the first-pass person, gender, age and essential color identity, and redraw only the issues below. The target deliverable is a single 74 x 100 pixel medieval RPG dialogue head: very large face, very short neck, true transparent background. Coarse hard-edged broad flat connected pixel clusters, intentional stepped contours, temporary palette at most 32 muted colors, no antialiasing, gradients or dithering. No text, border, props or extra people.
Make a focused second pass of THIS SAME fifty-year-old Risha face. Preserve her dark brick-red tied scarf, brown hair, warm mature face, broad blunt nose, olive work neckline and cream apron edge. Correct the drawing, do not just crop or scale the first image. Compact the red scarf fabric and its knot/tails, and pull all side locks inward, giving the face noticeably more of the composition. Maintain a fully intact silhouette with at least 2 target pixels transparent space at left and right, about 3 above. Nothing touches any edge. Reduce the curly hair to three broad connected masses with no tiny thin strands. Face should have solid wide mature cheeks, not gaunt elderly hollows. Remove the pinched raised inner brows and central forehead worry marks: two almost horizontal low relaxed eyebrows, steady practical appraisal. Make the eyes SMALL DARK narrow apertures, with only a tiny muted tan-gray sclera sliver, no glaring white rectangles or white pupil highlights. Keep a neutral straight closed mouth, neither sorrowful pout nor scowl. Keep subtle age folds at outer cheek/lower eye, but no despair. Neck almost entirely hidden behind jaw; only an extremely shallow olive collar and cream apron strip in final bottom 5–7%. Tight enlarged face and short neck, no chest. Broad cheek and nose shadow clusters, little texture.
This is the only revision. No story outcomes. Genuine transparency. The final NN/alpha/palette derivation will be disclosed as a derivative, not native pixel authorship.
